grandmother.definition: The mother of your father or mother.
grandmother.exampleUsage: Omar’s grandmother is his mother’s mother.

grandfather.definition: The father of your father or mother.
grandfather.exampleUsage: Omar’s grandfather is his father’s father.

great-grandmother.definition: The mother of one of a person’s grandparents.
great-grandmother.exampleUsage: Omar’s great-grandmother is his grandmother’s mother.

great-grandfather.definition: The male parent of a person's grandparent, making him that person's ancestor three generations back.
great-grandfather.exampleUsage: Omar’s great-grandfather is his grandfather’s father.

nana.definition: An informal family name for a grandmother.
nana.exampleUsage: Omar’s family calls his grandmother Nana.

papa.definition: An informal term for a father.

grandparent.definition: A parent of your father or mother.

aunt.definition: A parent’s sister, or an uncle’s wife; here a parent’s sister.
aunt.exampleUsage: Omar’s aunt is his mother’s sister.

uncle.definition: A parent’s brother, or an aunt’s husband; here a parent’s brother.
uncle.exampleUsage: Omar’s uncle is his father’s brother.

cousin.definition: A child of a parent’s sibling, or more broadly a related cousin.
cousin.arabicTranslation: ابن أو ابنة العم أو العمة أو الخال أو الخالة
cousin.exampleUsage: Omar’s cousin is his aunt’s daughter.

first-cousin.arabicTranslation: ابن أو ابنة العم أو العمة أو الخال أو الخالة
first-cousin.definition: A person whose parent is a sibling of your parent.
first-cousin.exampleUsage: Nora and Omar are first cousins because their mothers are sisters.

second-cousin.arabicTranslation: قريب من الدرجة الثانية في أبناء العمومة: أحد والديه ابن عم أو ابن خال لأحد والديك
second-cousin.definition: A person whose parent is a first cousin of your parent.
second-cousin.exampleUsage: Lina and Sami are second cousins because their parents are first cousins.

great-aunt.definition: The sister of a person's grandparent.
great-aunt.exampleUsage: Omar’s great-aunt is his grandfather’s sister.

great-uncle.definition: A brother of one of a person’s grandparents.
great-uncle.exampleUsage: Omar’s great-uncle is his grandmother’s brother.

niece.definition: A daughter of your brother or sister.
niece.exampleUsage: Omar’s niece is his sister’s daughter.

nephew.definition: A son of your brother or sister.
nephew.exampleUsage: Omar’s nephew is his brother’s son.

cousin-in-law.arabicTranslation: زوج أو زوجة أحد أبناء العمومة أو الخؤولة
cousin-in-law.definition: An informal name for a cousin’s spouse, or a spouse’s cousin; here a cousin’s spouse.
cousin-in-law.exampleUsage: Omar informally calls his cousin’s husband a cousin-in-law.

mother-in-law.definition: The mother of a person’s spouse.
mother-in-law.exampleUsage: Omar’s mother-in-law is his wife’s mother.

father-in-law.definition: The father of a person's husband or wife.
father-in-law.exampleUsage: Omar’s father-in-law is his wife’s father.

sister-in-law.definition: A sister of someone's spouse, or the wife of someone's sibling.
sister-in-law.arabicTranslation: أخت الزوج أو الزوجة، أو زوجة الأخ
sister-in-law.exampleUsage: Omar’s sister-in-law is his wife’s sister.

brother-in-law.definition: A brother of someone's spouse, or the husband of someone's sibling.
brother-in-law.arabicTranslation: أخو الزوج أو الزوجة، أو زوج الأخت
brother-in-law.exampleUsage: Omar’s brother-in-law is his wife’s brother.

son-in-law.definition: The husband of a person’s daughter.
son-in-law.exampleUsage: Nora’s son-in-law is her daughter’s husband.

daughter-in-law.definition: The wife of a person’s son.
daughter-in-law.exampleUsage: Nora’s daughter-in-law is her son’s wife.

in-laws.definition: Relatives connected to you through marriage, especially your spouse’s parents and other close family members.
in-laws.exampleUsage: Omar visits his in-laws, his wife’s parents.

spouse-s-family.definition: The relatives of a person's husband or wife.
spouse-s-family.exampleUsage: Omar’s spouse’s family includes his wife’s parents.

extended-in-laws.definition: An informal description of more distant relatives connected through marriage.
extended-in-laws.exampleUsage: Omar describes more distant relatives by marriage as extended in-laws.

family-in-law.definition: An informal description of family connected through marriage; in-laws is the usual term.
family-in-law.exampleUsage: Omar means his in-laws when he says family-in-law.

reunion.definition: A gathering of people who have been apart; here a family gathering.
reunion.exampleUsage: The relatives meet again at a family reunion.

holiday-dinner.definition: A special meal shared with family or friends on a holiday.
holiday-dinner.exampleUsage: The family shares a holiday dinner.

thanksgiving.definition: A holiday celebrated to give thanks, held on different dates in the US and Canada.
thanksgiving.exampleUsage: Some families in the United States have a meal at Thanksgiving.

christmas.definition: A Christian holiday celebrating the birth of Christ.

easter.definition: A Christian celebration of the Resurrection of Christ.

birthday-celebration.definition: An event held to mark the day someone was born.
birthday-celebration.exampleUsage: The family attends Nora’s birthday celebration.

anniversary.definition: The date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it).
anniversary.exampleUsage: The couple celebrates their wedding anniversary.

barbecue.definition: An outdoor meal where food is cooked on a grill; here the event.
barbecue.exampleUsage: The friends have a barbecue in the garden.

picnic.definition: Eating a meal outdoors, often on a blanket or table.
picnic.exampleUsage: The friends share a picnic in the park.

family-wedding.definition: A wedding involving or attended by family members.
family-wedding.exampleUsage: The relatives attend a family wedding.
